entries.title: Offering Zero Data Retention for frontier models
entries.summary: OpenAI reaffirms Zero Data Retention for eligible API customers and previews Private Safety Processing for advanced AI safety without compromising data privacy.

entries.title: Replit expands access to software creation with GPT-5.6 Luna
entries.summary: Replit introduces Free Mode, powered by GPT-5.6 Luna, so anyone can turn ideas into working software without worrying about token costs.

entries.title: ChatGPT Ads expands across Europe
entries.summary: ChatGPT Ads is expanding to 31 European markets. Learn how advertisers can reach people as they explore, compare options, and make decisions.

entries.title: Strengthening democratic oversight in national security
entries.summary: OpenAI launches an initiative to strengthen democratic oversight of AI in national security, supporting government institutions with tools, training, and expertise.

entries.title: Partnering with CodeAI to prepare the first AI generation
entries.summary: OpenAI and CodeAI are partnering to help students build AI literacy, think critically about AI, and develop the skills to use and shape it responsibly.

entries.title: Pacing model development in an era of cyber-critical capabilities
entries.summary: OpenAI is strengthening monitoring, alignment, and security for frontier AI models. See how new safeguards are guiding the pace of model development.

entries.title: Introducing ChatGPT for Teens: Built for learning, backed by protections
entries.summary: ChatGPT for Teens helps teens learn, think critically, and use AI with confidence, with stronger built-in protections, healthy-use features, and additional controls for parents.

entries.title: How NVIDIA scales expertise with ChatGPT Work
entries.summary: NVIDIA teams use ChatGPT Work to reduce manual tasks, connect fast-moving signals, and scale successful workflows globally.

entries.title: Asana cleared 5 years of engineering work in 2 weeks with Codex
entries.summary: Asana used OpenAI Codex to replace an outdated testing system in two weeks, completing work expected to take five years for about $12K.

entries.title: The Defender’s Window
entries.summary: AI is reshaping cybersecurity for attackers and defenders alike. Learn how OpenAI is strengthening its defenses and what security teams can do now.
